gloss: without permission; as one pleases; by itself

definitions.explanation: Doing something without asking or without regard for others, as one likes.
Of a thing: happening without anyone making it happen.

examples.japanese: {勝手|かって}に⟦{入|はい}らないで→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't come in without permission.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{勝手|かって}に⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧な。
examples.english: Don't use other people's things without asking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧もしないで{勝手|かって}に⟦{決|き}めて→決める：00858_kimeru⟧しまう⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: It's a problem when you decide things on your own without even consulting anyone.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{勝手|かって}に⟦{開|あ}いた→開く：00689_aku⟧。
⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{勝手|かって}に⟦{再起動|さいきどう}→再起動：09222_saikidou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The computer restarted on its own.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れていた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧とたん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{勝手|かって}にまぶた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{閉|と}じて→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧きた。
examples.english: I must have been tired: the moment I sat down, my eyelids started closing on their own.

notes:
⟦{勝手|かって}→勝手：03021_katte⟧ (one's own convenience) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Sense 1 usually carries criticism.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {勝手|かって}に〜ないで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please don't ~ without permission
- {勝手|かって}に⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do as one pleases
- {勝手|かって}に⟦しろ→する：00392_suru⟧！: Suit yourself! / Do what you want! (rude, said in anger)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: without notice or permission (more formal; no sense of "by itself")
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: naturally, by itself (neutral, no criticism)
